text.content:
Another Forsaken chamber in the Ossuaries, its purpose only clear in context with what's around it.

GM Notes

Encounter: This room refills with a new threat if left and returned to later, on the same table used for the floor's other random encounters.

Encounter: A patrol or wandering hazard tied to the floor's threat passes through this area on a rotation; a failed Perception check meets it head-on.
